name: Cyberdark Serpent
desc:
1 "Cyberdark" monster + 1 Dragon or Machine monster
Must first be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by Tributing 1 Dragon or Machine monster equipped with a Monster Card you control as material. If this card is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Cyberdark" monster from your Deck then equip this card to it as an Equip Card. While this card is equipped to a monster, it gains this effect.
● When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can: Immediately after this effect resolves, Xyz Summon 1 Xyz Monster using materials you control, including this card and the equipped monster, treat this card as a monster with the same Level as the equipped monster. You can only use each effect of "Cyberdark Serpent" once per turn.
strings: Special Summon from Extra Deck by Tributing equipped monster
Special Summon 1 "Cyberdark" monster from Deck and equip this card
